TAL_BEASTMASTERY_MEAT_SHIELD.why: Mounted Total Cover on a chosen edge and Reactive Cover's Martial Focus attack redirection (combat/ext/meat_shield.py).

tianxia.talent.shield.projected_shield_f.why: Flexible Cover's Shield Face becomes a 15-foot-wide plane centered on its edge and protects the creatures directly behind it (combat/ext/shield_faces.py, the directional_cover hook); the projected Face is attached to you and moves with you. Active Defense already applies to every attack roll on this table.

TAL_SHIELD_MOVING_RAMPART.why: Flexible Cover as a Bonus Action without Martial Focus, your movement does not end the Face, and one free change of edge during your turn (combat/ext/shield_faces.py); the Face still ends at the start of your next turn.

TAL_SHIELD_THE_MOUNTAIN_FITS_BEHIND_ONE_.why: Flexible Cover's Face is up to 30 feet wide (combat/ext/shield_faces.py); the forced-movement reduction and the Prone Advantage are not run (no forced-movement hook on a creature behind a face).

TAL_BERSERKER_DEATHLESS.why: Advantage on death saving throws, three times the maximum HP for massive damage, and Stable recovery after one saved 1d4-minute deadline (combat/ext/life_state.py).

tianxia.talent.life.soul_lamp_continuity.why: When you would die with at least 1 CP left, spend all your CP to keep a Soul-Lamp for a minute; when it ends, a Constitution save against DC 20 brings you back with 1 HP and a level of Exhaustion (combat/ext/life_state.py).

tianxia.talent.life.minute_gate_resuscit.why: One-Breath Resuscitation reaches a creature dead within the last minute, for 1 CP more once it has been dead longer than a round (combat/ext/life_state.py).

tianxia.talent.warleader.unending_loyalt.why: Recall Spirit reaches a creature that died within the last minute and gives back twice your CL + Warleader key modifier Hit Points (combat/ext/life_state.py); the death after an hour is out of a fight.
